title: Compact ops dashboard proposal — mobile-first alerting & sampling
content:
Purpose:
This doc proposes a compact operator dashboard and a mobile-first alerting strategy focused on fast triage for on-call SREs and product owners. Goal is to reduce noise, make critical signals consumable on small screens, and tie trace sampling to alert severity and cost constraints.

Scope and constraints:
- Target users: on-call SREs, incident responders, support triage leads.
- Environment: multi-tenant inference (hosted + dedicated).
- Constraints: query-cost limit for dashboards, trace retention budget, sampling budget per tenant.
- Non-goal: full replacement of existing long-form dashboards — this is a compact emergency/workbench view.

High-level UX concept (mobile-first):
1) Single-pane summary card at top: red/yellow/green health, top 3 active incidents, and active SLA burn rate.
2) Swipeable micro-panels (each panel fits a phone viewport):
   - Panel A: Customer-facing latency (p50/p90/p99) for top-5 tenants by traffic.
   - Panel B: Cost surge indicator (tokens/sec * model-weighted cost) + trending sparkline.
   - Panel C: KV cache warmth heatmap (per model pool) and cold-cache % by tenant.
   - Panel D: Error surface (rate of 4xx/5xx, model fallbacks engaged) with clickable drill-to-trace anchor.
   - Panel E: Recent sampled traces (compact list with trace-id, top error message, duration).
3) Quick actions: ack incident, mute tenant, jump to trace replay, request hot-restart. Buttons optimized for thumb reach.

Compact metric definitions (single-line forms for mobile display):
- operator_health: enum [ok, degraded, critical] derived from weighted SLO violations (weight: latency 0.6, errors 0.3, kv-warmth 0.1).
- p50_latency_ms, p90_latency_ms, p99_latency_ms: measured at model pool entry (exclude cached token hits).
- tokens_per_second: aggregated token emit rate across tenant or model pool.
- cost_rate_usd_per_min: token-rate * model_cost_factor (model_cost_factor table in linked artifact).
- kv_cache_warmth_pct: percent of requests served from prefix/KV cache in last 10m per tenant/pool.
- fallback_rate_pct: percent of requests that routed to fallback model or region.
- sampled_trace_count: number of traces stored for the tenant in retention window.

Trace tagging and anchor strategy (compact):
- Required tags on all traces ingested for mobile view: trace_id, tenant_id, model_family, route, call_path (e.g., prefix-kv, generate, rerank), error_flag.
- Anchor spans: identify the span with highest token-latency and surface its span id in mobile list for one-tap replay.
- Severity-mapped sampling:
  - severity=critical: sample 100% of traces for matching tenants (triggered by operator_health==critical).
  - severity=warning: sample up to 10% with priority for error_flag or p99 contributors.
  - baseline: sample 0.2% for general traffic but keep a headroom pool for bursts.
- Retention tiers: mobile-view recent traces kept for 7d for critical tenants; 24h for others, configurable via feature flag.

Sampling budget and cost controls (policy sketch):
- Global sampling budget (monthly trace-ingest spend) set by finance; dashboard should display current budget usage percentage.
- Per-tenant emergency credit (one-time override) gated by support role; recorded in audit log.
- Dynamic throttle: when cost_rate_usd_per_min spikes > 2x baseline, reduce baseline sampling to 0.05% automatically and elevate severity-based sampling only.

Alerting rules tuned for mobile consumption:
- Triage alert (severity=warning): p99_latency_ms > 2x baseline for 5m OR kv_cache_warmth_pct drop > 40% for 10m. Route to on-call channel + push notification.
- Critical alert (severity=critical): operator_health==critical OR fallback_rate_pct > 10% for 3m OR cost_rate_usd_per_min > budget threshold. Mobile push + SMS + escalation.
- Alert dedup & collapse: collapse multiple tenant alerts into a single multi-tenant incident when root-cause metric correlation > 0.7 (correlation window 10m).

Dashboard queries and widget notes (implementation hints):
- Keep queries under 3s for mobile panels. Use pre-aggregated rollups for p50/p90; compute p99 via approximate sketches where feasible.
- Use a lightweight JSON summary endpoint for the single-pane health card to avoid many roundtrips.
- Widget state should include a ‘last-updated’ timestamp and an indicator if data was sampled (so operator knows when trace list is incomplete).

Rollout plan and canary phases:
- Phase 0 (prototype): internal SRE-only alpha. Collect feedback on metric usefulness and button affordances.
- Phase 1 (beta): enable for 25% of incidents routing rules; A/B test alert noise vs existing dashboard.
- Phase 2 (gradual): enable mobile view for global on-call; integrate per-tenant sampling credits UI.

Operational checklist for launch:
- Instrumentation: ensure trace tags (see list) are added to all inference-edge spans.
- Query perf: precompute rollups for the top-5 tenants to ensure <1s loads.
- Alerting: add new mobile alert escalation chain in PagerDuty; test SMS fallback.
- Cost guardrails: set initial monthly trace budget and enable auto-throttle.
- Docs: short mobile triage quickcard for on-call teams and 2x walkthrough sessions.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to map model_cost_factor to real-time pricing when dedicated pools have committed discounts? (linked to JIRA-OBS-899)
- Exact thresholds for collapse correlation and multi-tenant incident heuristics (need historical analysis).
- Role-based access for per-tenant emergency credits: what approval workflow?

Notes to self / brainstorming fragments:
- Consider ‘silent’ mode for mobile during office hours with lower push aggressiveness.
- Could we add a one-tap ‘re-run probe’ that fires a synthetic request for the affected model pool and returns a compact result? Useful for fast verification.
- For cost visibility, a small sparkline with a red area when projected monthly spend crosses budget might be more actionable than a raw number.

References and links:
- CONFLUENCE-OBS-1234: metric-contracts reference (contains model_cost_factor table)
- JIRA-OBS-899: sampling-budget enforcement task
- github.com/redwood-inference/observe/PR-412: prototype mobile UI components

Next steps (short-term):
- Sync with Diego on trace tag rollout (this week).
- Build JSON summary endpoint + mobile wireframe (Rory + design).
- Schedule alpha with on-call rotation for early feedback (target: 2024-03-10).
